[[File:Sensali martial.jpg|right|200px]] The [[Sensali]] are a tribe of [[Canthan]] [[Tengu]] that live on [[Shing Jea Island]]. They are the enemies of the [[Angchu]] and [[Canthans]]. Like the Angchu, they hate [[Yeti]]s and are often seen attacking them.
